definition: One element of a house in the universal set every style draws from — a roof pitch, a cornice, a window head, the entry sequence. No style owns a slot: a style does not have a cornice, it specifies one.
basis: VISION.md, elements are the alphabet: "A universal set of element slots that every style draws from and none owns." and "The test of the ontology is that adding a style should never require adding a slot". docs/inheritance.md: "Georgian does not own a cornice — it specifies one." elements/slots.json lists roof_pitch, cornice, window_head_masonry and entry_sequence among its slots.
analogy: A letter of the alphabet every style writes with; adding a style should never need a new letter.
